BrochureContent.Content:
A Beautifully Presented Detached Coastal Home in an Exclusive Beachside Development
Nestled within the highly sought-after Sandycove development, No. 77 is a beautifully presented three-bedroom detached residence enjoying an enviable position just minutes walk from the development's private beach access and exclusive residents' tennis courts.
Designed with comfortable coastal living in mind, the property offers bright, spacious accommodation throughout. The welcoming entrance hallway leads to a generous front sitting room featuring a large bay window and an attractive fireplace with a solid fuel stove, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. From here there is access to the kitchen/dining room and living area which provides the perfect space for modern family living and entertaining. Two patio doors open directly onto the landscaped rear garden, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living and making it ideal for summer barbecues and alfresco dining. A convenient ground floor shower room/guest WC completes the accommodation on this level.
Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious ensuite master bedroom with a west facing balcony overlooking the landscaped garden. A spacious family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.
Outside, the private rear garden has been thoughtfully landscaped for low-maintenance enjoyment, featuring artificial grass, gravel areas, mature shrubs, and established hedging that provides excellent privacy. To the front, there is ample off-street parking.
Sandycove is an exclusive, gated coastal development finished to an exceptional standard, offering residents access to a range of superb amenities including private beach access, tennis courts, and a children's playground, all within beautifully maintained surroundings.
Ideally located just outside the charming village of Ballymoney, the property is only 7km from Gorey and approximately one hour's drive from Dublin, making it the perfect permanent residence, weekend retreat, or holiday home. The surrounding area offers an abundance of sporting and leisure facilities, including renowned golf courses, scenic coastal walks, and a wealth of cultural and recreational amenities.
No. 77 Sandycove presents a rare opportunity to acquire a superb detached home in one of Wexford's most desirable coastal developments, where privacy, quality, and seaside living combine to create an exceptional lifestyle.
Viewing is highly recommended
